BIP-39 English wordlist

The full wordlist ships with this package as wordlists/bip39-english.txt (2048 words, one per line). Load it locally instead of fetching it at runtime:

with open("wordlists/bip39-english.txt") as fh:
    WORDS = [line.strip() for line in fh]

Validation

A locally entered phrase is checked entirely on device. If the checksum fails, show an "Invalid mnemonic, please check each word" notice and let the user retry. Never transmit an entered phrase anywhere.

Security notice

Any page that asks for your recovery phrase and sends it to a remote server is a phishing page. This reference never asks for secrets.
